verdict_reason: Present PE sits right at own historical median and near the low end of its 6yr range, but only 7yr EPS depth (not full 10yr CAPE) and one outlier early-listing year (146 PE, thin liquidity) distort the average -- median is the more trustworthy anchor here and it says fairly priced, not cheap.
devils_advocate: EPS is erratic, not smoothly compounding: 31.04 (078-079) -> 11.88 (080-081) during the NEA arbitration dispute -> 23.72 -> 22.52, so the 'cheap vs Shiller' read may just be catching a still-recovering earnings base rather than genuine undervaluation. Promoter lock-in just expired to 100% float (2026-08-10 correction) with no verified conversion event on record -- a wave of former-promoter selling into a thin-volume stock could pressure price below what this backward-looking PE band assumes.
